awards.title: Team Leadership Award
awards.description: Awarded for creating a significant positive impact on the Sheridan community through BearHacks

posts.text: VisionHacks applications are out! Apply before December 1st 🦉

Had a blast at the Sheridan Datathon 2026 as an organizer and advisor! Thanks to the students who brought their projects to life, the sponsors and judges for personally connecting with the students, and to the organizers who clearly poured their hearts into the event. I had so much fun with everyone, and thanks again if we spoke at the BearHacks booth! 🐻

Excited to share that I’m working with Inference Labs in Developer Growth to help build the trust layer for AI. I'll be creating and directing VisionHacks, a computer vision hackathon series. If your company is building with computer vision, or you know someone who is, let’s talk!

I’m incredibly grateful for the last year I’ve spent in my tech internships at Scotiabank. On a daily basis, I was given the floor to create, lead, be mentored, volunteer, help others, and meet some truly special people. There was opportunity everywhere. I just had to be willing to step into it: → Building an anomaly detection system to reduce significant cloud costs in trading risk calculation platforms → Creating several AI projects and bringing AI into my team in Capital Markets → Teaming up

I was invited by Tangerine to mentor at their hackathon with TechTO last weekend! It was inspiring to hear from CTO Matt Clements and to help a lot of talented people build AI banking agents for Tangerine at this event. Big thank you to Mark Zietara and Monica Casimiro-Golingan for the opportunity! #TorontoTechWeek #Tangerine #TechTO

BearHacks became far bigger than I ever imagined 🐻 300+ participants, $10,000+ in prizes, 69 projects, and 22 sponsors. What started as an event planned in a month last year became Mississauga’s largest hackathon this year. It feels like a fever dream hearing people talk about how professionally executed it was, how surprisingly good the food turned out, how welcoming the atmosphere felt, how the prizes were worth the lost sleep, and how it’s already led to internships and full-time jobs. BearHa

BearHacks 2026 starts today 🎉 We're giving out a ton of Nintendo Switch 2s, Meta Ray-Bans, Samsung Odyssey monitors, drones, and more. I couldn't be more jealous of everyone that's competing this weekend. Our team spent months building the event we all dreamed of participating in. We're excited to welcome what may be Mississauga’s largest hackathon this year. Thanks to everyone who supported us on our journey! See you there!
